# that no witness can reach yet, with the argument and the commit that gives
# it a producer. A listed cell that a witness DOES reach fails the check
# (stale declaration); a cell listed here that the table does not declare
# fails too. EMPTY at L0: every L0 cell has a producer. Its first entry is
# planned at L2: (verify-at, attempt, ENDSET), no ENDSET producer on
# CAND_ROUTE_ATTEMPT until a reverse machine exists there.
